title: Week in Review, 2026-10-25 to 2026-11-01
notes:
## Week in Review, 2026-10-25 to 2026-11-01
### Velocity
100+ BRO issues completed (query capped at the first 100). 62 commits on main. Mix by title: mostly fixes (red test.yml, opening-night misses, data/score bugs), plus features (iOS show-page layout, quiz onboarding, money model, audience-grade threshold) and market expansion (UK regional phases, Chicago hub link, WestEndTheatre triage). No Daily Digest issues exist in Linear this week.
### Key Accomplishments
- Plan v2 lane work (BRO-6647..6651, 6669, 6672): lane watchdog, immediate deploy on publish, replays on every lane merge.
- UK regional coverage, audit and surfacing (BRO-6713, 6692, 6725, 6741, 6742).
- Opening-night fixes for The Heart / In the Heights (BRO-6670, 6676) and press-night probe fixes (BRO-6657, 6661).
- Prod deploy blocker from Sanity quota fixed (BRO-6659).
- Audience grade rules (BRO-6735, 6738), text contrast parity web/app (BRO-6673, 6675).
### Recurring Issues
- Label "auto-enriched" appeared on 15 completed issues, mostly P1 opening-night misses and scraper/ingest fixes. Consider a systemic fix.
- "main test.yml red: no-data-dependency unit tests" filed 4+ times (BRO-6683, 6727, 6740, 6748) plus BRO-6679, 6749. Same test gate going red repeatedly; needs a root-cause fix, not per-incident cards.
- Opening-night miss cards (BRO-6695, 6701, 6702) all for 2026-10-30 openings.
### Stale P0s
None: of 8 open Urgent/High-priority issues, none are in Todo/Backlog over 7 days or In Progress with no comment in 24h.
### Outcome Quality
64 of 100 completed issues lack one or more of the four Outcome sections (What changed, Why this approach, Gotchas, Discovered work); 52 lack all four (e.g. BRO-6760, 6749, 6748, 6741, 6740, 6738). Many are routine auto-closed cards.
### Workflow health
Failed runs, newest 100 of 1495 failures since 2026-10-25 (sample): test.yml push 24, land.yml push 19, check-corpus-drift.yml 11, execute-approved-fix.yml 8, llm-ensemble-score.yml 7, test-ugc.yml 5, replay-push-rescue.yml (schedule) 4. check-cron-health.yml failed on its last 3 runs (2026-10-29, 10-30, 10-31).
### Most Active Areas
data/audit ledgers (scraper-spend-ledger, alert-ledger, stage-latency, landings, deploy-watermark, needs-human-review) churn most; they are bot-written.
### Priorities for Next Week
1. Root-cause the repeating test.yml no-data-dependency failures.
2. Investigate check-cron-health.yml failing three days running.
3. Reduce land.yml and check-corpus-drift failures.
4. Enforce Outcome comment sections on close.
